replies.content: A 401 Unauthorized error for GET /products with your Admin API token means the token is missing, unknown, or revoked according to the docs on authentication errors. Please check that your token is correct, active, and has the needed scopes for this operation. Never share your real token in a chat; replace it with a placeholder if you mention it. If this does not resolve the issue, you may want to verify your token status or request a new one in your Kaizena Flow admin.
